items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 8:1
items.html: Just as there are three discernments in the general degree of ZA, which are: pregnancy, nursing, Mochin — meaning NRNHY of the lights, and KHB ZON of the vessels — so too there are these three discernments during the pregnancy of ZA itself, which are: the three days of absorption, the forty days of the formation of the fetus, and the three months for the recognition of the fetus, which comprise the NRNHY of the fetus. For the three days of absorption are the phase of Nefesh of the fetus, which is his phase of Assiya; and the forty days of the formation of the fetus are the phase of Ruach of the fetus, and his phase of Yetzira; and the three months for the recognition of the fetus are the NHY of the fetus, and his Atzilut. And these three discernments apply both in the discernment of the vessels and in the discernment of the sparks and in the discernment of the lights, and therefore they recur three times, in three chambers: in the first chamber they are the discernment of KHB ZON of his vessels; in the second chamber they are NRNHY of the sparks; and in the third chamber they are NRNHY of the lights. (Items 40 to 50).
